summary: Round 5 — pure refactor: AI explainer extracted into /app/backend/explainer.py (210 lines) with module-top imports (hashlib, json, OrderedDict, os, uuid). server.py dropped from 765 -> 604 lines and now does `import explainer` and `explainer.register_routes(api_router)` before the WIRE UP block. Behavioural contract verified unchanged: 38/38 prior pytest tests pass; +7 new round-5 regression tests pass; frontend Inspector explainer UI streams cold then replays cached (10.15s -> 0.87s = 11.7x speedup) with byte-identical text. One stale Round-3 static-source check (test_round3.py::test_explain_endpoint_503_path_in_code) had to be relaxed to also scan explainer.py since the 503 path naturally moved with the code. Otherwise zero issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: explainer.py is clean: 210 lines, module-top imports (hashlib/json/OrderedDict/os/uuid), pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore') keeps the schema forward-compat with extra fields, and `from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import ...` is correctly lazy-imported inside the route handler — keeps app import-time light, identical to Round 4.

register_routes() pattern is sound: server.py imports explainer once and attaches all three endpoints via `explainer.register_routes(api_router)`. No circular-import risk; _cache lives in the module so survives across requests but resets on backend reload (acknowledged behaviour).
Cache state is module-global which is fine for a single-worker uvicorn but would not de-dup across worker processes if --workers > 1 ever gets enabled. Non-blocking; spec calls for process-local.
Minor: explainer.py docstring header has a typo 'STANDAILONE' (intentionally matching the brand spelling used elsewhere in server.py — confirmed by grep, so consistent).

Minor: the @api_router.post path is defined inside register_routes (closure-bound to _cache and api_router). Reasonable for this size; if more routes accrete here consider an APIRouter() inside the module and a single `api_router.include_router(...)` call from server.py for clearer route registration semantics.
